headline: Earth Team
title: Earth Team | Grizbo Minespine and Bouldus | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Try this Earth team in Aniimo. Grizbo is the damage dealer, and it needs time to build rage. Minespine handles Break, and Bouldus supports with its rock moves. Add a healer such as Gracewing, or a regen like Somniwing. Guides suggest using the support and Break skills first to build buffs and energy, then switching to Grizbo. Guides differ on the last slot, so adapt to your box. Who leads your Earth team? Comment below!
description: A simple Aniimo Earth team: Grizbo on damage, Minespine on Break, Bouldus on support and a healer or regen such as Gracewing or Somniwing. Set up buffs first, then switch to Grizbo.
joke: My Earth team has one strategy: stand firm and look rocky.
